title: One clean orthographic view of one asset
description: Moodboard P6: one isolated piece in one strict orthographic view on the wearer's axes, one of a matched four-view technical set.

body.subject: Create a clean orthographic {{view}} view of the {{asset_name}}. Image A is the MetaHuman anatomical reference. Image B is the approved armor design / breakdown reference.
body.action: Generate only the {{asset_name}} as an isolated object in strict orthographic {{view}} view. Preserve the exact design, scale, materials, ornamentation, weathering, and construction from the reference. This must be the same object as in the other views, not a redesign.
body.camera: The view is defined on the wearer's axes. No perspective distortion; centered in frame; full object visible and uncropped.
body.style: Pure white or neutral light background; soft even studio lighting; no cast shadow.
body.constraints: Requirements: isolated object only; no character; no mannequin; no extra props; keep silhouette clean and readable; preserve accurate thickness and openings. This image is one of a matched four-view technical set for 3D generation.

view.default: FRONT (from directly in front of the wearer, looking at their chest)
enum: FRONT (from directly in front of the wearer, looking at their chest)
LEFT (from the wearer's own left side)
RIGHT (from the wearer's own right side)
view.description: the view, on the WEARER's axes

character_body.description: Image A: the MetaHuman anatomical reference (the anatomy sheet)

design_plate.description: Image B: the approved armor design / breakdown reference (this piece's multiview sheet)

openai/gpt-image*.note: GPT Image wants the reference order stated in prose and takes an explicit size (<= 3840 per edge, ~8.3 MP)

black-forest-labs/*.note: takes resolution + aspect_ratio; tolerates shorter prompts

google/gemini*.note: takes resolution + aspect_ratio; tolerates shorter prompts

sourceful/*.note: Riverflow: flattest albedo; takes resolution + aspect_ratio

gates.description: inspect every result: names and hashes cannot prove a view, a side or a scale

provenance.note: spruced up into the five-part spine; nothing lost: every original clause is mapped in prompts/moodboard_parity.json and checked by tests/test_moodboard_parity.py
